metadata.title: Stealth Browser Assistant — Stay private. Stay in control.
metadata.description: Instantly mute, hide or clean up sensitive browser tabs with a single shortcut. Lifetime license, no subscription.

hero.copy: Define sensitive tabs with your own keywords, then mute, hide, or clean them up instantly.

keywordMatching.heading: You decide what counts as sensitive.
keywordMatching.copy: Add any website, domain, or keyword. Stealth Browser Assistant detects matching tabs by checking their URL or title — entirely in your browser.
keywordMatching.note: Nothing is predefined. You choose what Stealth Browser Assistant protects.

shortcuts.copy: No searching. No clicking. Just press a key.
shortcuts.note: Default shortcuts shown for macOS. Fully customizable.

mute.name: Mute Tabs
mute.description: Silence matching tabs instantly without closing them.

hide.name: Hide Tabs
hide.description: Hide sensitive tabs from view while keeping them open.

emergency.name: Emergency Action
emergency.description: Mute, hide or close all matching tabs with one click.

clear.name: Clear Sensitive Data
clear.description: Wipe sensitive data such as browsing history and download history in one go.

emergency.heading: When you need everything gone.
emergency.copy: One click mutes, hides, or closes every matching tab instantly.

demo.heading: Take control in seconds.
demo.copy: Watch how Stealth Browser Assistant helps you stay private in any situation.

privacy.heading: Your browsing stays yours.
privacy.copy: Stealth Browser Assistant works locally in your browser. Your data is never collected or shared.
privacy.localMatching: Keyword matching happens locally. Your keywords, tab URLs, and browsing activity never need to leave your browser.

noData.title: No data collection
noData.description: Your browsing stays on your device.

noUploads.title: No uploads
noUploads.description: No browsing history ever leaves your browser.

noAccount.title: No account
noAccount.description: Use all features without creating an account.

steps.title: How to activate Premium
items: Your license key will be sent to your email.
Enter your license key at the bottom of the “{product}” settings page to activate.

safe.question: Is this extension safe?
safe.answer: Yes. Everything runs locally in your browser — nothing about your browsing is ever sent to a server. The extension requests only the permissions it needs to do its job.

data.question: Do you collect my data?
data.answer: No. No browsing history, no page content, no analytics, no telemetry. We have no servers storing your activity because we never receive it.

sites.question: Does it work on all websites?
sites.answer: Yes. It works on almost every site in your browser. If you run into any issues, feel free to reach out. You decide which keywords or patterns trigger each action.

license.question: How does the lifetime license work?
license.answer: Pay once, get a license key, and use it forever on any device you own. All future updates are included for free.

custom.question: Can I customize the keywords and shortcuts?
custom.answer: Absolutely. Add or remove keywords and change shortcuts to match your workflow — all from the extension's settings page.

detect.question: How does Stealth Browser Assistant detect sensitive tabs?
detect.answer: Stealth Browser Assistant matches your custom keywords against the URL and title of your browser tabs. Matching happens locally in your browser, so your browsing activity doesn't need to be sent to a server.

sections.body: All payment processes are securely handled by the Paddle platform. This tool only provides software authorization and does not store any user payment information.
